बॉलीवु़ड के गलियारों में गोविंदा और सुनीता आहूजा के रिश्ते को लेकर मची है बड़ी हलचल! 🍿
गोविंदा और कोमल रानी स्वर्णकार के कथित अफेयर और शादी की खबरों के बीच सुनीता का आया है नया बयान। 🧐
पिंकविला से बातचीत में सुनीता ने कहा कि वे और गोविंदा जल्द साथ लौटेंगे और पुराने दिन वापस आएंगे। ✨
सुनीता ने यह भी याद किया कि गोविंदा उन्हें घर की लक्ष्मी कहते थे और उनका यह 40 साल पुराना रिश्ता जरूर टिकेगा। 💛
हालांकि, सुनीता ने पहले दावा किया था कि गोविंदा और कोमल शादी की योजना बना रहे हैं और गोविंदा को 'sugar daddy' तक कह डाला था। 🤫
दूसरी तरफ, कोमल रानी ने इंस्टाग्राम पर लंबा नोट लिखकर आरोप लगाया कि सुनीता उनके पति को मेंटली परेशान कर रही हैं और सहानुभूति पाने की साजिश रच रही हैं। ⚠️
दिसंबर 2024 में सुनीता ने तलाक की अर्जी दाखिल की थी जिसे अगस्त 2026 में वापस ले लिया गया। 📝
क्या आपको लगता है कि गोविंदा और सुनीता की जोड़ी फिर से एक हो पाएगी? 💭

ctx.title: Sunita Ahuja is confident about reunion with Govinda amid his dating rumours with Komal Rani Swarnkar, says ‘nobody can ever separate us’
ctx.summary: Sunita Ahuja says she believes her 40-year marriage to Govinda will endure, recalling happier times and expressing hope they will be happy together again.
ctx.text:
Govinda and Sunita Ahuja 's relationship has been under the spotlight amid reports of trouble in their marriage and rumours of the actor's alleged affair with Komal Rani Swarnkar . Sunita recently claimed that Govinda and Komal were planning to get married and called the actor her alleged partner's ‘sugar daddy’. However, months after making the remarks, Sunita has now expressed confidence that she and Govinda will reunite.
In a conversation with Pinkvilla, Sunita recalled celebrating Diwali with Govinda and spoke about the gifts he would bring home for her. She said, "Earlier Govinda used to buy me gold, give gifts. We would go shopping for all the shagun we got from him. Sometimes he would even take me and Tina to buy jewellery. Those days would come again soon, and we would go jewellery shopping together."
Sunita also recalled how Govinda used to call her ‘ghar ki laxmi (the one who brings prosperity and good fortune to the family)’ and said she would always stand by him because he was her childhood love. She further addressed Govinda's objection to her use of abusive language, defending herself by saying that she did not feel the need to be sophisticated in front of him.
She then expressed hope of seeing her happy family back again and said, "Of course, we will see; why won’t we? Right now, the time isn’t in our favour, and you can't fight time. It’s a 40-year-old marriage; why won’t it sustain? It’s fine; he’s doing what he likes. I am working, and my entire focus is on work, but nobody can ever separate us in this lifetime. Rest, I’ve left it all to the Almighty. Apart from God, I don’t ask anything from anyone. Whatever is right for him, and me, God will bless us with that."
The rift between Govinda and his wife, Sunita, began following the actor's rumoured relationship with his Roopa co-star Komal Rani Swarnkar. The couple, who got married in 1987 and have two children, have been making headlines over marital troubles for nearly two years. Sunita had reportedly filed for divorce in December 2024, citing adultery, and cruelty, but later withdrew her petition in August 2026. She subsequently claimed that Govinda and Komal were planning to get married, an allegation that the actor's manager denied.
The controversy intensified after Govinda and Komal were spotted together at Mumbai's Lalbaugcha Raja pandal in September, while Sunita had visited the same pandal separately. Sunita then called Govinda 'sugar daddy' of Komal Rani. Reacting to Sunita's remarks, Komal shared a lengthy note on Instagram Stories without directly naming her or Govinda. She wrote, "Nobody ever can be a homebreaker in already broken house." She also questioned Sunita's decision to discuss her marital problems publicly, suggesting that it was a carefully planned conspiracy to gain sympathy.
Komal further alleged that Sunita was mentally harassing her husband, stopping him from working and isolating him. She concluded by asking people not to use her name to serve an agenda. Following Komal's post, Sunita said she had nothing to say about Govinda or his co-star. In an interaction with Sarish Media, she said, "I see that he is happy; God bless him. Let him live his life the way he wants to." She added that her main focus was now her work and that she did not want to get involved in controversies repeatedly.
Sunita is set to make her Bollywood debut playing the role of her son, Yashvardhan Ahuja's mother in Sajid Khan's upcoming movie. Backed by Ektaa Kapoor, the film also stars Nitanshi Goel in a lead role and is expected to release in theatres next year.
